cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel; do cp $D/$f.py $D/$f.py.bak_before_stake; curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f.py" -o $D/$f.py; done
chown -R tbot:tbot $D
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel; do /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile $D/$f.py && echo COMPILED $f; done
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 10; systemctl is-active classicbot
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python - <<EOF
import json, urllib.request
j=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8091/api/trades?sym=ZECUSDT&bars=960", timeout=200))
T=j["trades"]
print("tf", j["cfg"]["tf"], "период", j["cfg"].get("period_from"), j["cfg"].get("period_to"), "| сделок", len(T), "| net%% %+.2f" % sum(x["net"] for x in T))
print("money:", j["money"])
print("первые сделки (net%, ставка, \$):", [(round(x["net"],2), x["stake"], x["usd"]) for x in T[:4]])
print("cfg ставка:", {k: j["cfg"].get(k) for k in ("stake_mode","stake_base","stake_min","martingale","mart_pct","mart_max")})
r=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8091/api/runs", timeout=100))
for x in r["runs"]: print("прогон", x["id"], x["stats"]["n"], x["stats"].get("money"))
EOF
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/ | grep -c "Размер ставки"
